title: European Central Bank survey: 44% of employed EU consumers reported using AI weekly at work in August, on par with US peers; 18% used it daily, above US levels (Alexander Weber/Bloomberg)
summary: Alexander Weber / Bloomberg: European Central Bank survey: 44% of employed EU consumers reported using AI weekly at work in August, on par with US peers; 18% used it daily, above US levels — Euro-area workers are turning to artificial intelligence at a similar rate as their peers in the US, though obstacles remain …
